tool_input.content:
import gzip, io, sys
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont

SRC = r"D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端\src\static\fonts\ref8443"
DST = r"D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端-wt-fonts\src\static\fonts\ref8443"

pairs = [
    ("NotoSansSC-VF_2.woff2", "NotoSansSC-VF_2.woff2"),
    ("PlusJakartaSans_wght__2.woff2", "PlusJakartaSans_wght__2.woff2"),
]

for src_name, dst_name in pairs:
    src_path = SRC + "\\" + src_name
    dst_path = DST + "\\" + dst_name
    with open(src_path, "rb") as f:
        raw = f.read()
    # detect gzip and decompress
    if raw[:2] == b"\x1f\x8b":
        data = gzip.decompress(raw)
    else:
        data = raw
    # data should be TTF/OTF now
    font = TTFont(io.BytesIO(data))
    # set flavor to woff2
    font.flavor = "woff2"
    font.save(dst_path)
    # report
    import os
    print(f"{dst_name}: in={len(raw)} decompressed={len(data)} woff2_out={os.path.getsize(dst_path)}")
print("done")
